item.description: A prominent Queensland jockey who admitted to strangling a woman until she saw "stars", has lost his bid to appeal his sentence.

item.title: ABC News: Teenager arrested after plea for information about 'Onepercent' profile
item.description: Detectives last month called for information about who was behind the handle as they investigated a series of firebombings and extortions on bars, clubs and restaurants in Melbourne.

item.title: ABC News: Lloyd Rayney files legal action against Facebook giant Meta
item.description: The former Perth barrister is seeking to compel the tech giant to disclose the identities of people who may have been involved in defamatory Facebook comments about him.

item.title: ABC News: Australian Rohingya hope world will listen after UN court's genocide ruling
item.description: Rohingya Australians welcome the International Court of Justice's judgement that Myanmar committed genocide against the Muslim minority group but say the decision must be backed up by action from the international community including Australia.

item.title: ABC News: Police warn rock-throwing targeting cars in WA could be fatal
item.description: A Kununurra resident says she has been left hundreds of dollars out of pocket after a group of children threw what is believed to be a large rock at her car.

item.title: ABC News: Controversial birthing model abandoned after community backlash
item.description: A birthing-model trial in South Australia's Mid North has been abandoned one month after it began, after a significant community backlash.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: David Jones staff issued with redundancy notices
item.description: More than 1,600 David Jones staff have been issued with redundancy notices after the iconic retailer went into voluntary administration earlier this month

item.title: ABC News: Police charge three men who allegedly detained man in dog cage in remote NT
item.description: Northern Territory Police have charged three men in the remote community of Wadeye for allegedly assaulting a man and holding him overnight in a dog cage, with a video of the incident recently coming to light.

item.title: ABC News: Man charged with murder of 71-year-old woman at Whitsunday home
item.description: The man remains in police custody and will appear before the Proserpine Magistrates Court in December.

item.title: ABC News: Police investigate council staffer's alleged $30k credit card fraud
item.description: The Glenelg Shire Council alleges a former staff member misused council money after calling in a forensic investigator to examine accounts.

item.title: ABC News: Calls for One Nation candidate to withdraw from election over misconduct
item.description: Anti-violence campaigners say One Nation candidate Garner Smith should not be running in the Victorian election after breaching five standards of conduct while a Gannawarra councillor.

item.title: ABC News: Teen to stand trial over Cairns high school stabbing
item.description: A 15-year-old boy accused of stabbing a fellow student with a knife during a fight at their high school in July has been committed to stand trial.

item.title: ABC News: Cricketers' association slams 'disgraceful' treatment of Sandpapergate players
item.description: The head of the Australian Cricketers' Association has urged people to consider the human element of the story, branding the "hounding" of some players outside their homes as "absolutely disgraceful".
